items.rationale: Clauses 2.3.3, 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude the cost of translating the police report, even though reporting the robbery was a condition of cover.
Clauses 7.1.8(e) and (f) exclude the translator's working materials and any ancillary charges billed alongside the excluded translation.

The reported robbery is covered under 2.3.1–2.3.3. Under 7.1.9 the upgrade is disregarded; the equivalent watch is expected to exceed the €2,500 per-item valuables cap, leaving €2,375 after allocating €125 of the single €150 deductible pro rata.

The roughly €900 nominal cash loss is capped at €500 under 2.3.2, 4.2.3 and 6.2.4; the combined capped loss of €3,000 is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit. Allocating €25 of the single deductible under 7.8 leaves €475.
The sunglasses were mislaid later, not taken in the robbery, so clauses 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude them.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes shipping even on an otherwise covered settlement, and 5.2.3 does not cover delivery of replacement property or forwarding of documents.
